overview.title: Transparent & High-ROI Fees
overview.text:
Investing in culinary training is an investment in your career. Chef course fees in Bangladesh vary, but Culinary Academy is committed to full transparency and providing the highest return on investment (ROI). We cover all premium training materials, kitchen gear, and high-quality raw ingredients within a single transparent fee.

Our flagship Professional Chef Course costs BDT 44,000 in total. We do not charge any extra fees for ingredients, uniform, knife kits, or certification. To make this career training accessible to everyone, we offer customized installment options.

highlights.title: 3 Installments
highlights.description: Easy payment options: BDT 16k + BDT 14k + BDT 14k.

highlights.title: No Hidden Costs
highlights.description: All raw ingredients, uniform, and kits included.

features: Complete chef uniform and professional knife kit provided free
All raw cooking ingredients covered (including premium beef, cheese, salmon)
Guaranteed 5-star hotel internship placement at no additional cost
National Skill Development Authority (NSDA) assessment and registration fees covered
Flexible monthly installment structures for students and low-income families
Partial merit-based scholarships and waivers for deserving candidates

faqs.question: Are there any extra charges for ingredients at Culinary Academy?
faqs.answer: No. Unlike other cooking schools that require students to purchase their own ingredients or pay extra kitchen fees, Culinary Academy covers the cost of all raw ingredients (from meats to continental sauces).

faqs.question: What is included in the BDT 44,000 Pro Chef fee?
faqs.answer: The BDT 44,000 fee includes admission, all practical class ingredients, a professional chef uniform, a chef knife, a cutting board, recipe books, and the final NSDA Level 2 assessment.

faqs.question: How can I apply for a fee waiver or scholarship?
faqs.answer: Deserving candidates, female entrepreneurs, and students from low-income families can apply for our Culinary Academy Opportunity Waiver, offering BDT 5,000 - BDT 10,000 off the total fee. Contact our counselor for details.
